name: Following Your Heart
overview: Scripture teaches that the heart is central to the believer's life and relationship with God, calling for trust in the LORD rather than reliance on one's own understanding or desires. While the heart can be a source of life and joy, as seen in the call to delight in the LORD and find strength in Him, it must be guarded diligently because trusting in one's own heart apart from God is folly. Moreover, walking wisely and with God’s guidance leads to deliverance, and even youthful enthusiasm must be tempered by the awareness of divine judgment.
